name: Suzuhara Takashi
source:
He lived his life with a dull personality and a dull appearance. He quit his job and came back to the countryside to rely on his parents. Turns out, his parents left the country to spend the rest of their lives in the tropics.

He doesn't have a girlfriend, and all his friends have left the countryside, and he rarely see them. When he watch dramas and cartoons in which people are living a glorious adolescence, he thinks to himself “I wish I could have lived such a youth!"

He spends his days in front of the TV gritting his teeth. He grumbles about his dull and boring life without even trying to change it.

But then he met a god of eroticism who made his body smaller and made him more popular. His hobby is to go out to the city once a month and play UFO catcher.
